text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening after training, I spot a
group of
students heading back to the
dorms.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Excellent work, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Same goes for you! And that marks the
end of
another busy week!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Keeping my eyes on the weekend
prize is
how I blasted through training! I
hope I can still
move tomorrow! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of, do you all have anything
planned?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
If you're free, I was wondering if we
could—

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAAUGH!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huuuh?! Wh-what's wrong?!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Oh no, I just remembered! Hear me out! It's awful!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
I have some wonderful news to share
with you all.

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
Earlier this week, Winning Ticket was
awarded a
Model Citizen Award for
saving an elementary
schooler from
getting caught up in a traffic
accident.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Uwaaaagh! It was nothing! But thanks for
the
mention!

text_block_list.name: Teacher A
text_block_list.text:
However, there was a quiz on the day of
the
awards ceremony, so you'll be
coming in over the
weekend to make up
for it.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: WAAAAH! No waaaaay!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
So, I've gotta take that quiz all by
myself! I'm so
saaaad!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry to hear that... But at least you
can take
the quiz with honor...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um... I actually have plans too...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Sis is dragging me out shopping for new
cleats.
She keeps harping about how it's
time I got them
replaced.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to a fan meet-and-greet event
with
Fukukitaru and Bright...

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
And I've been tasked with the sacred
mission to
teach the kids in the park how
to do backflips.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
My apologies, but I have Mejiro
estate-related
business tomorrow that
must be taken care of.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sounds like you've all got things of your
own to
do, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, there are some things
that can
only be done during the
weekend... Was there
something you
wanted to do?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Oh, um, nope! It's nothing, so don't
worry about
it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next day, I spy a familiar student
standing by
the empty racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Huff... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
All righty! Time for a little break, and
then one
more lap...
Spe? Is that you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Tickezo?! What are you doing here? I
thought
you had a quiz...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Yep, and now I can bask in sweet,
SWEEEEET
freedom! Figured I'd blow off
some steam by
doing a few laps!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Wait... What's everyone doing here?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I finished with my errand, so I dropped
by for a
run.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The kiddos know how to backflip like
ninjas
thanks to my expert tutelage! My
work is done!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I wrapped up shopping with Sis, so...
Here I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
So everyone completed their errands
and made
their way here, I take it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! Actually, I was going to ask you
all
yesterday if you wanted to do some
training
together!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What are the odds that we'd all end up
in the
same place at the same time like
this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, true. We did all have very
different plans
for how to spend our day.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...But there is a common thread
connecting us all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Oh? What is it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: We're all racing toward our dreams.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
We cannot stand still and wait for our
dreams to
come to us. We all know that,
and so our coming
here wasn't so much
by chance as it was an
inevitability.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Wooow... Yeah! You're absolutely right!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as the gang's all here, why don't
we have a
race?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Let's see, how does 2,400 meters
sound? Same as
the Derby!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. I came here to do hill sprints.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, too bad! We're all gathered here,
which
means we have to race! Everyone,
strap on your
pedometers! Whoever has
the most steps after a
lap around the
track gets bragging rights!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hwuuuh?! How're we gonna make up our
minds if
we're all over the place?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Well, we may be bound by the common
thread of
following our dreams... But it
seems those dreams
can't be neatly
woven together.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The teammates realize that although
they all have
dreams, each one is
personal—no two dreams are
alike.
